hero.title: A pioneer in
hero.lead: Our efforts are driven by digitization, ecological cognizance, productivity, innovation and adaptability, through a three-pronged approach to how we make things and how we treat people.

approach.title: Three pillars, one commitment
approach.intro: Sustainability is not a side project at Apex. It is built into our plants, our materials and our everyday operations.

pillars.title: Environmental friendliness
pillars.summary: Cleaner water, safer chemistry and less waste in every process.
points: One of the largest privately owned water treatment plants in the country
Singeing and sublimation to reduce dye and chemical waste

pillars.title: Recyclable materials
pillars.summary: Turning waste into new fibre and choosing better raw materials.
points: Pre-consumer waste recycled into new fibre
Recycled polyester, ocean plastic, bamboo and organic cotton
Online scrap platform with Reverse Resources

pillars.title: CSR in daily operations
pillars.summary: Investing in our people and the communities around our factories.
points: Fair Wage Method developed with the ILO

water.title: Every drop treated, every process cleaner
water.text: We operate one of the largest privately owned water treatment plants in Bangladesh and continue to research ways of recycling wastewater. Across our factories, chemicals follow the Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals (ZDHC) guidelines.

efficiency.title: Doing more with less
efficiency.intro: Small engineering changes, multiplied across factories and offices, add up to large savings in energy, dye and chemicals.

items.title: LED lighting
items.text: CFL lights replaced with LEDs across all our factories and offices.

items.title: Servo motors
items.text: Clutch motors replaced with efficient servo motors on our production floors.

items.title: Waste heat recovery
items.text: Waste heat from power generation runs our air-conditioning and cooling units.

items.title: IFC PaCT programme
items.text: Energy initiatives in our dyeing houses are part of the International Finance Corporation's PaCT programme.

items.title: Singeing and sublimation
items.text: Textile processes that cut dye wastage and reduce chemical use.

materials.title: Better fibres, by design
materials.intro: We work with a growing range of recycled, renewable and certified materials.

grs.title: Global Recycle Standard
grs.text: Our GRS certification allows voluntary, third-party assessment of our recycling efforts.

loop.title: From fabric scrap to new fibre
loop.intro: Together with Reverse Resources, we run an online platform that lets recycling spinners see the fabric scrap available, closing the loop on pre-consumer waste.

steps.label: Cutting floor
steps.text: Pre-consumer fabric scrap is collected and sorted.

steps.label: Online platform
steps.text: Scrap availability is listed with Reverse Resources.

steps.label: Recycling spinners
steps.text: Spinners source the scrap they need.

steps.label: New fibre
steps.text: Waste is spun back into new fibre.

people.title: We are determined to invest in our people
people.intro: Corporate social responsibility is mainstreamed into our everyday operations, with a focus on the welfare of employees and the communities around our factories.

items.title: Safe drinking water
items.text: Clean, safe drinking water for our workforce and communities.

items.title: Medical care
items.text: On-site medical centres for employees and their families.

items.title: Transport service
items.text: Employee transport to and from our factories.

items.title: Childcare
items.text: Daycare centres with certified caregivers for working mothers.

items.title: Training
items.text: Regular sessions on financial literacy and nutrition.

items.title: Fair Wage Method
items.text: Developed with the International Labour Organization to address wage gaps in garment manufacturing.

cta.title: Let's make responsible manufacturing the standard
cta.text: Talk to us about certified materials, compliance or partnering with one of our companies.
